page.notes: Greek words and lemmata are uncertain at several points, marked [?]; the Greek accents and breathings may not match the printed form exactly. The Greek header at the start of the second paragraph and the Greek words in the Ὄφρα line are the least certain. The text runs to the page foot without a catchword. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "ipfa" is read as "ipsa".
